changes.name: Berserk
changes.before:
Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Causes your Mangle ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.
changes.after:
Requires Cat Form, Bear Form, Dire Bear Form
Causes your Primal Bite ability to strike up to 3 targets, removes its cooldown, and increases the critical strike chance of your Combo Point-generating abilities by 100%. Clears and grants immunity to Fear effects for the duration. Lasts 15 sec.

changes.name: Blood Frenzy
changes.before: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.
changes.after: Gives you a 100% chance to gain an additional 5 Rage any time you get a critical strike while in Bear Form or Dire Bear Form. In addition, your non-periodic critical strikes from Cat Form abilities that generate Combo Points have a 100% chance to add an additional Combo Point.

changes.name: Ferocity
changes.before: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Mangle, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.
changes.after: Reduces the cost of your Maul, Primal Bite, Swipe, Claw, and Rake abilities by 5 Rage or Energy.

changes.name: Primal Bite
changes.before: Mangle the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.
changes.after: Bite the target for 100% normal damage plus 26.

changes.name: Strider Kick
changes.before: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage.
changes.after: A powerful kick that deals 100% melee weapon damage and increases movement speed by 30% for 3 sec.

changes.name: Hot Streak
changes.before: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 15 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.
changes.after: Your non-periodic critical strikes with Fireball, Frostfire Bolt, Fire Blast, and Scorch grant Hot Streak for 20 sec. Hot Streak reduces the cast time of Pyroblast by 25%, stacking up to 3 times.

changes.name: Wake of Fire
changes.before: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 20 sec by 50%.
changes.after: Reduces the cooldown of your Fire Blast spell by 2 sec. Killing a non-trivial target increases the critical strike chance of your next Fire Blast cast within 30 sec by 50%.

changes.name: Crusade
changes.before: Increases all damage dealt by 2%. Increased by an additional 2% against Demon and Undead targets.

changes.name: Holy Power
changes.before: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock spell by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike chance of your Holy Shock and Holy Strike spells by 15%, and all other spells by 5%.

changes.name: Improved Holy Strike
changes.before: Reduces the cooldown of your Holy Strike ability by 2 sec.

changes.name: Light's Vigil
changes.before: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes friendly targets to heal their party for 324, or enemy targets to suffer 182 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost. You may only have 1 Light's Vigil active per Paladin, per party.
changes.after: Applies Light's Vigil to the target for 30 sec. Your next Holy Shock cast on them triggers no cooldown and causes enemy targets to suffer 182 Holy damage and refund 75% of Light's Vigil's Mana cost, or allied targets to heal their party for 324. The Paladin may only have one Light's Vigil active per party.

changes.name: Sacred Arbiter
changes.before: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 10% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.
changes.after: Increases the damage of your Holy Strike ability by 20% and causes it to refresh all Judgement effects on the target.

changes.name: Twist of Light
changes.before: When you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.
changes.after: Reduces the Mana cost of your Seal spells by 20%, and when you replace your Seal of Command, Seal of Righteousness, Seal of Fury, or Seal of Justice with a different Seal, gain an Echo of that Seal. Your next melee attack applies the replaced Seal's effects, consuming the Echo.

changes.name: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization
changes.before: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 9%.
changes.after: Increases the damage you deal with two-handed melee weapons by 6%.

changes.name: Vengeance
changes.before: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a critical strike. Stacks up to 5 times.
changes.after: Increases your Physical and Holy damage dealt by 3% for 30 sec after landing a non-periodic critical strike. Stacks up to 3 times.

changes.name: Devouring Contagion
changes.before:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague it is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yards for the remaining duration.
changes.after:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by 50%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within 10 yards for the remaining duration.

changes.name: Call of Thunder
changes.before: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 3%.

changes.name: Elemental Alacrity
changes.before: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.
changes.after: Reduces the cast time of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Lava Burst spells by 0.50 sec.

changes.name: Elemental Fury
changes.before: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.
changes.after: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

changes.name: Lava Burst
changes.before: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 113 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.
changes.after: You hurl molten lava at the target, dealing 164 Fire damage. If your Flame Shock is on the target, Lava Burst deals 20% increased damage.

changes.name: Rage of the Farseer
changes.before: Increases your melee attack speed and spell casting speed by 30% for 25 sec.
changes.after: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

changes.name: Bloodthrill
changes.before: Your melee attacks against targets afflicted by your Rend have a 10% chance to activate your Overpower ability for 1 attack on your current target. Lasts 6 sec.
changes.after: Your Main Hand melee attacks against enemies afflicted by your Rend have a 20% chance to allow the use of your Overpower ability on the target. Lasts 6 sec.

changes.name: Improved Slam
changes.before: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts your melee swing time.
changes.after: Reduces the global cooldown and cast time of your Slam ability by 0.50 sec. In addition, Slam no longer interrupts or delays your melee swing and Slam's cooldown is reduced by 3.0 sec.
